title: Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation
abstract: arXiv:2610.28567v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. translated_title: 通过残差空间适配实现扩散模型中的持续概念个性化
translated_abstract: 文本到图像个性化旨在使预训练的扩散模型具备仅从少量参考图像中学习用户特定概念的能力。然而，现有方法通常独立训练每个概念，或假设所有概念同时可用。在实际应用中，概念往往按顺序到达，这要求模型在持续学习新主体、物体或风格的同时，尽量减少对已获取概念的干扰。我们通过将残差空间适配扩展到预训练扩散模型的随机适配过程，来解决这一持续概念个性化问题。我们的工作在各类竞争性持续个性化方法中实现了最高的概念保真度，同时保持近乎零的遗忘。除了这些实证收益之外，学习到的残差空间动态还揭示了适配容量在扩散模型内部的集中位置。限制适配（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出将残差空间适配扩展到预训练扩散模型的随机适配过程中，实现了持续概念个性化，在保持近乎零遗忘的同时达到了所有竞争方法中最高的概念保真度。
en_tdlr: This paper extends residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models for continual concept personalization, achieving the highest concept fidelity among competing methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting.
